lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 fixed a review round 1 WARNING: checkClaudeEffortSupport (src/commands/run-effort-preflight.ts:40) had no direct unit test, so its four documented fail-closed branches (spawnFn throws synchronously, spawnSync sets result.error on ENOENT without throwing, non-zero/null exit status, and the string-vs-Buffer stdout coercion) were never exercised in isolation -- the only prior coverage (test/commands/run-effort-argv.test.ts:214-238) merely asserted the probe was called, with its fake spawn always returning status 0 and empty stdout (exactly one path: supported=false via missing substring). Added test/commands/run-effort-preflight.test.ts, a dedicated unit-test file importing checkClaudeEffortSupport directly from src/commands/run-effort-preflight.ts (not the run.ts re-export), mirroring the FakeSpawnOpts/makeFakeXSpawn helper convention already used by test/commands/run-auth-preflight.test.ts for the sibling checkClaudeAuth probe. Ten tests: spawnFn-throws, result.error-set (ENOENT), non-zero exit, null exit (signal), missing-substring stdout, empty stdout, string-stdout-contains-substring (true path), Buffer-stdout-contains-substring (true path, since real spawnSync without an explicit encoding returns Buffer not string), Buffer-stdout-missing-substring (false), and an argv-shape assertion that the probe calls `claude --help`. No production code changed -- this was a pure test-coverage gap fix, no external library surface touched (SpawnFn/spawnSync types are node:child_process ambient types already exercised elsewhere in the codebase). No further review round 1 findings remain queued in this handoff; the supervisor's review-cycle bookkeeping determines whether another round dispatches.
